domain.description: The broad domain of the operation (e.g., payment, auth, navigation)

event.description: The triggering event that occurred (e.g., payment_debited)

condition.description: The condition or context of the event (e.g., order_missing)

action.description: The possible or required executable action (e.g., resolve_orphan_transaction)

confidence.description: Confidence score propagated from Intent IR
